description: Structural diff of two JSON documents: list of added / removed / changed values with JSON Pointer paths and old/new values, an RFC 6902 JSON Patch that turns a into b, and counts. Arrays are aligned by longest common subsequence (inserted items show as inserts, not a cascade of changes) or matched by an id field. POST JSON body {a, b}. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/json-diff

arrayKey.description: Match array elements that are objects by this field (e.g. "id") instead of by position

title: Json Diff
